color.note: Two layers: a base palette (surface, ink, ochre, red, hairline) and semantic shadcn/ui names that point to it. Components use the semantic names.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page. A warm off-white, a warm near-black in the dark theme.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Quiet surfaces: cards, tiles, hover fills. ink-muted on it 5.1:1.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Stronger surface: disabled fills, secondary tiles. ink-muted on it 4.6:1 – short lines only.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark stage for video and photo sections, dark in both themes.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating docks with background blur. Always with a hairline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the primary button. Warm near-black on light (16.8:1), warm off-white on dark (16.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of ink fills. Text on it 11.6:1 light, 12.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, meta (5.6:1 on the page, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-display-muted
tokens.usage: The grey second line of a large headline. 3.3:1 light – large type only, 24px and up.

tokens.name: ink-unread
tokens.usage: Words not yet read in ScrollFillText. A passing state, never lasting text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and dark photos.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Decorative lines and image placeholders. Never text (2.6:1).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: The one accent, for small things only: the square mark, the focus ring, a highlight. 5.1:1 on the page, 8.6:1 dark. Never a button fill.

tokens.name: ochre-tint
tokens.usage: Text highlight behind a few words. ink on it 14.3:1 light, 13.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: a muted dark red, never pastel. Light: white on it 8.3:1, as text 8.0:1. Dark: #b0402f, off-white on it 5.6:1, as a line 3.3:1 on the page. Error text in the dark theme is set in ink, with the red square and line carrying the colour.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Surface of error alerts. ink on it 13.9:1 light, 15.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Fixed off-white over photos and video, both themes.

tokens.name: on-media-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an on-media button.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders, table lines.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Control lines: the input underline, outline buttons, checkboxes.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: page background.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: default text.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: card surface – a quiet fill, no border, no shadow.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: menus, select lists, toasts, dialogs.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: the primary button – near-black on light, off-white on dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: text on primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Extension: hover of primary. shadcn/ui falls back to primary/90.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: secondary buttons and badges.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: muted areas and disabled fills.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: labels, descriptions, placeholders.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: hover background of ghost buttons and menu rows. Neutral here – the brand accent is mark.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: destructive buttons and error states.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive fills (8.3:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: Extension: error messages. Red text on light (8.0:1); in the dark theme ink text, because a readable red there would turn pink.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: borders and dividers.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: input underlines and control borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui: focus ring, 2px with 3px offset.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Extension: the square mark and small highlights.

tokens.name: mark-tint
tokens.usage: Extension: the text highlight behind a few words.

styles.name: display-wordmark
styles.usage: One word, very large: a name as hero or above the footer. −4 %. Mobile 120px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One statement per screen. −4 %, the second line in ink-display-muted. Mobile 56px.

styles.name: feature-title
styles.usage: Titles in FeatureStack, AudienceCard and dialogs at large size. −3 %.

styles.name: display-serif
styles.usage: The editorial accent: Instrument Serif in capitals, +4 %. Rare – an event, a chapter, a pull quote.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Type carries the page. Images bring the colour.

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: A practice that feels like the room
styles.usage: Titles in cards and case entries. −2.5 %.

styles.name: letter
styles.usage: A personal letter in the serif, about 26em wide.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: “The site was online two weeks later.”

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Serif capitals above titles, +14 % tracking. The kicker and section eyebrows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Serif capitals for meta lines, tile numbers and state labels, +14 %.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a pair, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside cards, between text and image.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page margin, between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections. A lot of air is the style.

radius.note: Square. Everything has 0px corners; only avatars and radio buttons are round.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: shadcn/ui base radius. 0 makes every rounded-* utility square.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, badges, dialogs, images – everything.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars and radio buttons only.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover on links and images: opacity, underline.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Colour changes of buttons and the navigation bar.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Content that arrives on scroll (Reveal), image zoom.

tokens.name: dur-entrance
tokens.usage: Hero lines arriving on load.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: Loops like the scroll hint. Never more than one loop per screen.

tokens.name: delay-1
tokens.usage: Stagger step 1: headline.

tokens.name: delay-2
tokens.usage: Stagger step 2: subline, second headline line.

tokens.name: delay-3
tokens.usage: Stagger step 3: buttons.

tokens.name: dur-overlay
tokens.usage: Full-screen overlay (CaseStory) fades in after 200ms.

tokens.name: dur-ring
tokens.usage: A slow rotating ring around the case thumbnail. Barely noticeable.

tokens.name: dur-scrub
tokens.usage: Smoothing for everything that follows scroll (ScrollFillText, BlurList, CardFan, FeatureStack).

tokens.name: dur-marquee
tokens.usage: One pass of the TestimonialRail. Very slow, pauses on hover.

duration.note: Short for interaction, longer for storytelling.

tokens.name: ease-entrance
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives: hero entrance, reveal, image zoom. Fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover and colour changes (CSS ease).

tokens.name: ease-loop
tokens.usage: Back-and-forth loops (ease-in-out), e.g. the scroll hint.

easing.note: Two curves are enough: a soft brake for things that arrive, the standard ease for state changes.

tokens.name: rise-sm
tokens.usage: Hero entrance: lines rise 16px.

tokens.name: rise-md
tokens.usage: Reveal on scroll and the content sheet sliding over the hero.

tokens.name: bob
tokens.usage: Travel of the scroll hint.

tokens.name: zoom-media
tokens.usage: Image zoom on hover in a project tile.

tokens.name: blur-near
tokens.usage: BlurList: neighbour of the active line.

tokens.name: blur-far
tokens.usage: BlurList: lines further away.

tokens.name: tilt
tokens.usage: CardFan: rotation per card in the fanned stack.

tokens.name: fan-overlap
tokens.usage: CardFan: offset of cards in the stack.

distance.note: How far things move. Keep it small: motion should be felt, not watched.

shadow.note: Almost none. Surfaces are flat; only things that float get a soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, toasts, docks.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: App or website window in a MediaFrame.
